items.item:
11. A correction that changes a project moves its revision by exactly one and
   sets its last-changed instant to the current instant; one that changes
   nothing leaves both. Shows A04-3, A04-6.
   [witness: verification:registry_a04_change_moves_revision_and_last_changed]
statements:
```text
answer(a) = first failing check of a in the order (1)..(6), else its effect   -- A04-1
for action a on record r in {Project, Customer} that may move r.revision:
  a.stated_revision != r.revision => refused, r unchanged   -- A04-2
  accepted and changed(r) and r keeps a revision   -- A04-3
                          => r.revision' = r.revision + 1
                             and r.last_changed' = now
  accepted erasure, anonymisation or deletion => r has no revision after   -- A04-4
  r has no revision and a.stated_revision present => refused as stale   -- A04-5
  accepted and not changed(r) => r.revision' = r.revision   -- A04-6
```

                          => r.revision' = r.revision + 1

verdicts.why: The check asserts that each changing correction advances the project revision by exactly one and stamps last_changed_at with the advanced clock's current instant. It also asserts that an accepted correction with identical values reports no change and preserves both the revision and last-changed instant.
